name: order-api

dependencies.description: Stores orders, their status history, and courier assignments.
dependencies.name: order-db

dependencies.description: Validates the caller's Thunder-issued token and resolves their role (Customer, Staff, Delivery Courier) for authorization.
dependencies.name: user-auth

dependencies.description: Sends the customer-facing email notification whenever an order's status changes. No specific vendor is named in the requirements.
dependencies.name: email-provider

description: Ballerina service owning the order lifecycle: order creation (manual staff entry and an inbound API endpoint the external storefront website calls to create orders), status transitions (Placed, Processing, Shipped, Out for Delivery, Delivered, Cancelled), status history, courier assignment, and triggering customer email notifications on status change. Does not handle payments, inventory, returns, or courier route optimization.
